n86d0c013e9.headline: The treasury has a golden bottom. Salaries in the public sector are growing significantly faster than in companies | Aktuálně.cz
n86d0c013e9.summary: In the Czech Republic, public sector salaries increased significantly faster than those in private companies last year, with an average salary of 35,437 crowns.
n86d0c013e9.why: Wage growth disparities affect labor markets, public finances, and economic competitiveness in the Czech Republic.
